title: Mass of the plane varifold v(T) over a closed ball about 0
statement: For T ∈ G(N,n) and r > 0, v(T)(B_r(0) × G(N,n)) = ω·ofReal(r)^n, where v(T) = planeVarifoldMeasure T = (H^n⌞T).map (y ↦ (y,T)), B_r(0) is the closed ball, and ω = unitBallVolume n.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → planeVarifoldMeasure T (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) r ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
